description.value: A McDonald's franchise on Annacis Island in Delta, situated in an otherwise industrial area that sees cyclists crossing between Delta and the broader Metro Vancouver cycling network. The location offers drive-through, curbside pickup, and app-based ordering, making it a practical fuelling stop for riders in an area with limited food options. Free Wi-Fi is available per OSM tagging, consistent with McDonald's Canada standard practice.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is an active McDonald's location at 1285 Cliveden Avenue (Delta/Annacis Island). OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes and internet_access=wlan; the website corroborates takeout via explicit mention of Drive-Thru, Curbside, and McDelivery services. The OSM street name 'Cliveden Place' conflicts with the website URL and page title which read 'Cliveden Avenue' — flagged as a concern. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill details are present in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records 'Cliveden Place' but the website URL and page title use 'Cliveden Avenue' — address updated to website version.
OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but the location is on Annacis Island, which is within the City of Delta.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast food restaurant in an area with limited food options — straightforward include for the directory.
